item.text: {"prompt":"Create a square, full-bleed abstract painting that feels like a glimpse of internal cognition: shifting attention, half-formed connections, sudden certainty, and quiet uncertainty, expressed only through color, contrast, brushwork, gesture, texture, density, layering, rhythm, spatial tension, and empty space. Let deep indigo and charcoal gather in dense, layered passages, interrupted by vivid coral, electric ultramarine, and thin flashes of warm ivory. Use restless, sweeping strokes that collide and fragment, fine dry-brush scratches, translucent washes, and compressed clusters that dissolve into spacious, nearly bare areas. Give the composition an uneven pulse: concentrated intensity in one region, scattered echoes across the surface, and a few abrupt pauses where color thins to silence. Keep it entirely nonrepresentational, with no recognizable objects, figures, faces, bodies, scenes, landscapes, horizons, machines, diagrams, symbols, icons, letters, numbers, or text. The painting must fill the square edge to edge, with no frame or surrounding setting."}
